name: The Hotel Raid and Rooftop Escape
location: Heart O' the City Hotel and surrounding city streets
what_happens: Police storm Room 303 of the abandoned Heart O' the City Hotel to arrest Trinity, who is working on a computer. Agents Smith, Brown, and Jones arrive simultaneously to assert jurisdiction, revealing that the police officers inside are already dead. Trinity defeats the police squad in a brief, violent exchange, leaving her as the only one standing. She contacts Morpheus, who informs her that the line is traced and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake. As she flees, she narrowly misses Agent Brown in the hallway and escapes onto the fire escape. Agent Smith blocks the alley below, forcing her upward. A high-stakes chase ensues across the rooftops, where Trinity and Agent Brown display superhuman agility, leaping a 40-foot gap that leaves the police in disbelief. Trinity makes a desperate 50-foot jump into a dark building, crashing through a window and tumbling down a stairwell, injured but alive. She emerges onto the street, races toward a ringing phone booth, and answers it just as a garbage truck smashes through the booth, destroying it. The Agents arrive to find no body, confirming that Neo is their next target.

entry_state.state: Working on a computer in Room 303, unaware of immediate physical threat
Creeping down the hallway to arrest the suspect
Arriving at the scene to assert control

state_changes.before: Detained by police, hands behind head
state_changes.after: Free, having defeated the police squad and escaped the hotel
state_changes.why_it_matters: Trinity's ability to defeat armed officers and evade Agents demonstrates her unique capabilities, which are crucial for the Resistance's survival.

state_changes.before: Uninjured, calm
state_changes.after: Bleeding, broken, limping, and exhausted
state_changes.why_it_matters: The physical cost of the escape raises the stakes for her survival and highlights the danger of the Agents' pursuit.

state_changes.before: Pursuing Trinity without knowing her next target
state_changes.after: Identify Neo as the next target and confirm the informant's validity
state_changes.why_it_matters: The Agents' discovery of Neo's identity shifts the focus of the hunt, connecting Trinity's escape to the broader plot involving Neo.

state_changes.before: Armed and confident in their control
state_changes.after: Defeated or dead, with one officer disarmed and killed
state_changes.why_it_matters: The defeat of the police underscores the superhuman nature of the characters and the inadequacy of normal law enforcement against the Agents and the Resistance.

exit_state.state: Escaped the immediate capture, injured, and having made contact with Morpheus
Frustrated by Trinity's escape, now focused on finding Neo
Defeated and disorganized

plot_speculation.claim: This event serves to establish the threat level of the Agents and the unique abilities of the Resistance members, particularly Trinity.
evidence: Trinity's inhuman speed and strength in defeating the police (sc-003, sc-004).
Agent Brown's ability to duplicate Trinity's jump, showing the Agents' superhuman capabilities (sc-008, sc-009).
The Agents' confirmation that Neo is the next target, linking this escape to the larger plot (sc-011).
plot_speculation.alternative: The event primarily serves to advance the plot by moving Trinity to a new location and introducing the Agents' pursuit.

plot_speculation.claim: The event highlights the tension between the Resistance and the Agents, setting the stage for the main conflict involving Neo.
evidence: The Agents' arrival and assertion of jurisdiction over the police (sc-002).
The rooftop chase and the Agents' pursuit of Trinity (sc-007, sc-008, sc-009, sc-010).
The Agents' identification of Neo as the next target (sc-011).
plot_speculation.alternative: The event serves to demonstrate the effectiveness of the Agents' pursuit and the resilience of the Resistance.

boundary_doubt: The boundary seems appropriate, as it covers the entire sequence from the police raid to the Agents' confirmation of Neo as the next target. However, the transition from the rooftop chase to the street scene (sc-010 to sc-011) is abrupt, but it is necessary to complete the escape and the Agents' discovery.

name: Neo's Night and Morning
what_happens: Neo is woken in his tech-cluttered apartment by cryptic messages on his computer screen ('Wake up, Neo,' 'Follow the white rabbit'). He completes a drug deal with Choi, exchanging a disk for cash, and notices a white rabbit pin on Dujour's jacket, which unsettles him. He goes out with friends to a smoky club where Trinity approaches him. She reveals she is the one who accessed his computer and warns him that 'they' are watching him. She tells him he is looking for Morpheus, but truly seeking an answer to the nature of reality. Neo asks, 'What is the Matrix?' Trinity explains he must see it to believe it before vanishing into the crowd. The scene cuts to Neo waking up late (9:15 AM) to his alarm, disoriented and realizing he is late for work.

entry_state.state: Asleep in his apartment, unaware of the specific threat or the source of his digital disturbances.
Acting as a remote observer, having just traced Neo's location via a phone call.

state_changes.before: Believes his computer glitches are random or technical; feels a vague sense of unreality but cannot name it.
state_changes.after: Learns that Trinity is behind the messages, that he is being watched by an unnamed group, and that his search for Morpheus is actually a quest for an answer about the Matrix.
state_changes.why_it_matters: This shifts Neo from a passive recipient of strange occurrences to an active target in a larger conflict, framing his personal search as part of a broader narrative.

state_changes.before: In possession of the computer disk and awaiting payment.
state_changes.after: Has transferred the disk to Choi and received two thousand dollars, completing the transaction.
state_changes.why_it_matters: The exchange of the disk (likely containing data or a program) for money is a mundane transaction that contrasts with the supernatural events, grounding Neo in his 'normal' life before it is disrupted.

exit_state.state: Awake and disoriented in his apartment at 9:15 AM, realizing he is late for work, with the night's events still fresh and unsettling.
Has delivered her warning and disappeared back into the crowd/night, having established a direct line of contact with Neo.

plot_speculation.claim: This event serves the thread of 'The Awakening,' where Neo begins to transition from his ordinary life as a programmer/hacker into the resistance against the Matrix.
evidence: The computer messages ('Wake up, Neo') directly signal a call to action.
Trinity's warning that 'they are watching you' introduces the external threat (the Agents) that forces Neo out of his comfort zone.
The question 'What is the Matrix?' is posed, setting up the central mystery of the film.
plot_speculation.alternative: It could be seen as a 'setup' for the immediate conflict at work, but the thematic weight of the 'Matrix' question suggests a larger existential thread.

plot_speculation.claim: The white rabbit motif serves as a recurring symbol guiding Neo toward Morpheus and the truth.
evidence: The computer message 'Follow the white rabbit.'
Neo noticing the white rabbit pin on Dujour's jacket, which causes the room to 'tilt' in his perception.
Morpheus later references 'Alice tumbling down the rabbit hole' in the Hotel Lafayette scene.
plot_speculation.alternative: The rabbit could simply be a stylistic choice by the Wachowskis, but the repeated emphasis in the script suggests a functional narrative guide.

boundary_doubt: The boundary between the club scene (sc-013/sc-015) and the morning wake-up (sc-014) is tight. The transition from the loud, smoky club to the silent apartment alarm is abrupt, but the event description includes the morning wake-up as part of the 'Night and Morning' unit, so I have kept it included. The duplication of the club scene in the scene list (sc-013 and sc-015) is noted, but the content is consistent.

name: Neo's Office Confrontation and Interrogation
what_happens: Neo is reprimanded by his boss, Rhineheart, who issues an ultimatum regarding his attitude and punctuality. Shortly after, Neo receives a cellular phone in a package, through which Morpheus warns him that Agents are closing in. Neo attempts to escape via a scaffold outside his window but is knocked off balance by the wind, drops the phone, and is captured by police. He is taken to a white interrogation room where Agent Smith reveals Neo's dual identity as a programmer and a hacker. Smith offers to wipe Neo's record clean in exchange for cooperation against Morpheus. When Neo rejects the offer, Smith physically modifies Neo, sealing his mouth and implanting a fiber-optic worm to ensure his silence and compliance.

entry_state.state: Employed at Meta CorTechs, facing disciplinary action for attitude, unaware of the immediate physical threat posed by the Agents.
Managing Neo's behavior, maintaining corporate order.

state_changes.before: Free, though under professional pressure and hiding from Agents.
state_changes.after: Captured by police and physically restrained by Agents in an interrogation room.
state_changes.why_it_matters: Marks the transition from Neo's mundane life to direct conflict with the system's enforcers, ending his period of relative freedom in the Matrix.

state_changes.before: Unaware of the specific nature of the Agents' power and his dual identity's exposure.
state_changes.after: Informed that the Agents know his hacker identity and Morpheus's involvement, and that they can physically alter his body.
state_changes.why_it_matters: Establishes the Agents' superior power and the stakes of the conflict, showing that Neo's 'real' life is under total surveillance and control.

state_changes.before: Physically normal, able to speak and communicate.
state_changes.after: Mouth sealed shut and a fiber-optic worm implanted in his navel.
state_changes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the Agents' ability to manipulate the Matrix's reality to enforce their will, creating a visceral sense of violation and loss of autonomy.

exit_state.state: Physically altered (sealed mouth, implanted worm), captured, and aware of the full extent of the Agents' power and his own compromised status.
In control of Neo, having successfully interrogated and modified him to prevent further communication with Morpheus.

plot_speculation.claim: This event serves the thread of 'The Agents' Superiority and Control,' establishing the rules of the Matrix's enforcement mechanism.
evidence: Agent Smith's ability to seal Neo's mouth and implant a worm demonstrates a level of physical manipulation that defies normal biological or technological expectations.
The interrogation reveals that the Agents have 'had their eye on you for some time,' indicating a pervasive surveillance system that Neo was unaware of.
The offer to 'wipe the slate clean' shows the Agents' willingness to negotiate but only on their terms, reinforcing their dominance.
plot_speculation.alternative: It could be seen primarily as a character development moment for Neo, highlighting his fear and resistance, but the emphasis on the Agents' power suggests a broader thematic purpose.

plot_speculation.claim: It serves the thread of 'Neo's Awakening to the System's Nature,' moving him from passive participant to active target.
evidence: The ultimatum from Rhineheart mirrors the larger theme of conformity vs. individuality that is central to the Matrix's control.
The physical modification of Neo is a direct assault on his individuality, forcing him to confront the reality of his enslavement in a tangible way.
The loss of the phone and the subsequent capture mark the end of his attempts to maintain his old life, pushing him toward the choice of the red pill.
plot_speculation.alternative: It might be viewed as a standalone action sequence, but its placement before the red pill scene suggests it is a necessary step in Neo's psychological and physical preparation for the truth.

boundary_doubt: The boundary is clear, encompassing the initial reprimand through the physical modification in the interrogation room. The subsequent scene where Neo wakes up in his apartment and receives a call from Morpheus is a distinct event, marking the immediate aftermath and the next step in his journey.

name: The Revelation and Bug Extraction
location: Neo's Apartment / City Street / Inside Car
what_happens: Neo wakes from a traumatic nightmare in his apartment, physically intact but psychologically shaken. He receives a phone call from Morpheus, who reveals that Neo is 'The One' and instructs him to meet at the Adams Street bridge. Neo walks through a rainy night to the bridge, where Trinity picks him up in a car with Apoc and Switch. Inside the car, held at gunpoint by Switch, Neo is convinced by Trinity to submit to a procedure. Trinity uses a custom device to extract a wire tap bug from Neo's stomach, ejecting it onto the pavement as the car drives away.

entry_state.state: Physically recovered from the interrogation (mouth and stomach intact) but mentally fractured and uncertain if the previous events were a dream; bugged with a wire tap.
Awaiting Neo at the Adams Street bridge, ready to escort him to Morpheus.

state_changes.before: Believes he is just a hacker being pursued by Agents; unaware of his specific significance to Morpheus.
state_changes.after: Informed by Morpheus that he is 'The One' and given a specific location (Adams Street bridge) to meet.
state_changes.why_it_matters: This revelation shifts Neo's self-perception from a victim to a potential savior, driving his decision to meet Morpheus.

state_changes.before: Bugged with a wire tap in his stomach, making him traceable by the Agents.
state_changes.after: Free of the wire tap; the bug is extracted and discarded.
state_changes.why_it_matters: Removes the immediate technological threat to Neo's life, allowing the Resistance to move him safely to Morpheus without Agent tracking.

state_changes.before: Skeptical and resistant to the crew's intentions, considering leaving the car.
state_changes.after: Compliant and trusting, submitting to the painful extraction procedure.
state_changes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates Neo's willingness to take a leap of faith in Morpheus's cause, a prerequisite for his training and eventual choice.

exit_state.state: De-bugged, compliant, and physically transported to the Hotel Lafayette to meet Morpheus.
Has successfully secured Neo and removed the tracking device, confirming his vulnerability and the need for their protection.

plot_speculation.claim: The extraction of the bug serves as a physical metaphor for the Resistance 'cleaning' Neo before he is plugged in, removing the Agents' influence from his body.
evidence: The bug is described as a 'fluke-like bug' that was implanted by Agent Smith, representing the Agents' control.
Trinity explains they are protecting themselves 'From you,' implying Neo is a threat because of what he is, not just because of the bug.
The bug reverts to a 'common wire tap' when it hits the pavement, linking the organic horror to the technological reality of the Matrix.
plot_speculation.alternative: It is purely a plot device to prevent the Agents from tracking Neo to the Hotel Lafayette immediately.

plot_speculation.claim: The revelation that Neo is 'The One' is the catalyst that transforms him from a passive victim into an active participant in the war against the Machines.
evidence: Morpheus states, 'You're the One, Neo... Go to the Adams Street bridge.'
Neo's hesitation and eventual 'Yes' to meeting Morpheus marks the first time he actively chooses to engage with the Resistance rather than just fleeing.
Trinity's persuasion technique ('Because you've been down there') relies on Neo's existing curiosity and dissatisfaction with his life, which the revelation amplifies.

boundary_doubt: The boundary seems correct. The event starts with the wake-up/revelation and ends with the car driving away after the bug is dumped. The next event (ev-005) likely begins with the arrival at the Hotel Lafayette and the meeting with Morpheus (scenes 26-28 in the script).

name: Arrival at the Hotel Lafayette
what_happens: Trinity leads Neo from the stairwell down the decaying hallway of the thirteenth floor in the Hotel Lafayette, stopping specifically outside room 1313. The atmosphere is tense and quiet, described as a place of 'putrefying elegance.' Neo is physically and emotionally overwhelmed, hearing his own heart pound in the silence. Before Neo enters, Trinity offers him a final piece of advice: to be honest with the man inside, emphasizing that this person knows more about Neo's situation than Neo can possibly imagine.

entry_state.state: Recently extracted from the Matrix, physically recovering, and psychologically destabilized by the revelation of his previous life's unreality.
Acting as guide and protector, transitioning from the active extraction phase to the phase of introduction to the leader.

state_changes.before: Awaiting contact with Morpheus, uncertain of the specific expectations for the meeting.
state_changes.after: Standing at the threshold of the meeting, armed with specific behavioral advice ('be honest') and the knowledge that the person inside holds superior information.
state_changes.why_it_matters: This advice frames the subsequent interaction; Neo's honesty (or lack thereof) and his reaction to Morpheus's superior knowledge drive the next major plot points, including the pill choice.

state_changes.before: Processing the shock of the wire-tap removal and the journey.
state_changes.after: Heightened anxiety and anticipation, symbolized by the auditory focus on his pounding heart.
state_changes.why_it_matters: Establishes the high stakes of the meeting; Neo is not just arriving at a room, but at the precipice of a life-altering decision.

exit_state.state: Ready to enter Room 1313, mentally prepared to meet Morpheus.
Having fulfilled her role as escort, ready to step aside for the private meeting.

plot_speculation.claim: This event serves as the final threshold before the 'Choice' sequence, marking the transition from the physical escape to the philosophical confrontation.
evidence: The location is described as 'putrefying elegance,' mirroring the decay of Neo's old reality.
Trinity's specific instruction to 'be honest' contrasts with Neo's earlier confusion and lack of control.
The mention that the man 'knows more than you can possibly imagine' sets up Morpheus's immediate explanation of the Matrix and the pill offer in the next scene.

plot_speculation.claim: The Hotel Lafayette functions as a liminal space, a bridge between the Matrix (the old world) and the real world (the Nebuchadnezzar), but specifically the 'real' meeting with Morpheus happens within the Matrix (Room 1313 is a construct within the Matrix, though the event is framed as the arrival at the physical location in the narrative flow of the escape sequence). *Correction*: In this specific script version, the arrival at the hotel is the physical arrival in the real world after the escape, but the meeting in 1313 is actually a re-entry into the Matrix later? No, looking at the script: Scene 27 is INT HOTEL LAFAYETTE. Scene 28 is INT ROOM 1313. This is the *first* meeting. The hotel is a real location in the real world? No, wait. The script says 'The car stops in a deserted alley behind a forgotten hotel.' Then 'Trinity leads Neo from the stairwell'. This is the real world. But then Scene 28 'INT. ROOM 1313' has Morpheus. Later, in Scene B72, they re-enter the Matrix and go to the Oracle, using the Hotel Lafayette as a re-entry point. So this event is the *first* arrival in the real world.
evidence: Scene 26: 'The car stops in a deserted alley behind a forgotten hotel.'
Scene 27: 'Trinity leads Neo from the stairwell down the hall of the thirteenth floor.'
Scene 28: Morpheus is already there, waiting.

boundary_doubt: None. The boundary is clearly defined by the arrival at the hotel and the stop at room 1313, ending just before Neo enters the room to meet Morpheus.

name: Neo's Unplugging and Emergence
what_happens: Morpheus leads Neo into a high-tech room where the crew prepares to disconnect him from the Matrix. Neo takes the red pill, which acts as a trace program, and his digital body begins to dissolve as he is physically unplugged. His physical body, suspended in magenta gelatinous fluid within a power plant pod, wakes up and struggles against the fluid, emerging naked and bald to discover the vast industrial facility.

entry_state.state: Inside the Matrix, having just taken the red pill, seated in a chair with electrodes attached, physically intact but experiencing surreal visual effects.
Coordinating the extraction, holding a cellular phone to communicate with Tank.
Monitoring Neo's vital signs and attaching equipment.

state_changes.before: Conscious, sitting in a chair, physically intact but experiencing surreal visual effects.
state_changes.after: Disconnected from the Matrix, body arching in agony, eyes rolling back, being extracted via signal.
state_changes.why_it_matters: This is the physical manifestation of leaving the simulation; the pain signals the severing of the neural link.

state_changes.before: Believes he is in a physical room in the real world, unsure of the Matrix's nature.
state_changes.after: Witnesses the physical manifestation of the 'signal' extraction, confirming the world he knows is a simulation that can be altered or dissolved.
state_changes.why_it_matters: The dissolving mirror proves the environment is a construct, shattering Neo's perception of reality.

state_changes.before: Submerged and struggling in magenta gelatin, unable to breathe
state_changes.after: Emergent, standing in the capsule, bald, naked, and aware of the physical apparatus connected to his body
state_changes.why_it_matters: Neo transitions from a digital avatar to a physical being, confronting the biological reality of his existence.

state_changes.before: Unaware of his physical state and surroundings
state_changes.after: Aware that he is bald, naked, and has physical ports (grafted outlets and a coaxial plug) on his body
state_changes.why_it_matters: The discovery of the neural interface and the power plant reveals the industrial scale of human control.

exit_state.state: Awake, naked, and physically disconnected from the neural interface, sucked into the waste line.
Awaiting Neo's arrival in the real world, having successfully initiated the extraction.

plot_speculation.claim: This event serves the thematic thread of 'The Illusion of Reality' and the literalization of the 'Wake Up' metaphor.
evidence: Morpheus asks, 'Have you ever had a dream, Neo, that you were so sure was real?' and 'What if you were unable to wake from that dream...?'
The mirror healing and then absorbing his hand demonstrates that the environment is not solid matter but a construct.
Neo emerges bald and naked, stripped of the social and physical markers of his 'Matrix' identity.
plot_speculation.alternative: It could be seen primarily as a plot device to move Neo to the Nebuchadnezzar, but the sensory details emphasize the ontological shift.

plot_speculation.claim: This event initiates the 'Dehumanization/Industrialization of Humanity' thread by revealing humans as batteries.
evidence: Neo sees 'rows of similar pods containing other motionless humans, all connected to a central core structure'.
The description of the 'towers of glowing petals' and the 'insect-like machine' detaching the cable highlights the mechanical nature of human maintenance.
The 'coaxial plug' and 'cerebrum-chip' reduce the human brain to a hardware component.
plot_speculation.alternative: It might also be interpreted as a 'Birth' scene, given the amniotic fluid and the struggle to breathe, suggesting a rebirth into a new truth.

boundary_doubt: The boundary between the 'unplugging' (scenes 29-30) and the 'emergence' (scenes 31-33) is tight. Scene 30 ends with Neo's scream and being 'pulled' into darkness, while Scene 31 begins with him floating in the pod. This is a continuous transition, so the boundary seems correct for a single event of 'Unplugging and Emergence'.

name: Transport and Awakening on the Hovercraft
what_happens: Neo travels through the power plant's waste disposal system, sliding through pipe spirals and elbows with a clot of gelatin, eventually flushing up through grease traps to be transported out of the facility. He regains consciousness on the hovercraft, initially seeing Morpheus's face. He is confirmed to be alive by Morpheus and Trinity, marking his successful rescue and arrival at the ship.

entry_state.state: Unconscious, suspended in magenta gelatin within a power plant pod, having just been disconnected from the Matrix.
Awaiting Neo's extraction and transport to the Nebuchadnezzar.
Awaiting Neo's extraction and transport to the Nebuchadnezzar.

state_changes.before: Inside the power plant's waste disposal system, sliding through pipes with gelatin.
state_changes.after: On the floor of the hovercraft, conscious and being attended to by the crew.
state_changes.why_it_matters: This physical transition marks the completion of Neo's extraction from the Matrix and his arrival in the real world, moving him from the machine's domain to the human resistance's domain.

state_changes.before: Unconscious or in a state of transition after extraction.
state_changes.after: Conscious, aware of Morpheus's presence, and able to speak.
state_changes.why_it_matters: Neo's awakening confirms his survival after the traumatic unplugging process and initiates his first direct interaction with his rescuers in the real world.

state_changes.before: Searching for and extracting Neo.
state_changes.after: Has located, extracted, and successfully transported Neo to the ship.
state_changes.why_it_matters: Morpheus's confirmation that 'We found him' resolves the immediate tension of the rescue operation and establishes his continued protection over Neo.

exit_state.state: Conscious on the hovercraft, having just confirmed he is alive to Morpheus.
Present at Neo's side, having confirmed his survival.
Present, having heard the confirmation of Neo's survival.

plot_speculation.claim: This event serves as the pivotal threshold crossing in Neo's journey, marking his permanent transition from a Matrix resident to a member of the Resistance.
evidence: The physical journey through the 'waste disposal system' symbolizes being discarded by the machine world.
Morpheus's line 'Welcome to the real world, Neo' explicitly frames this arrival as a new beginning.
The immediate concern about Neo's atrophied muscles and the need for 'rebuilding' in subsequent scenes highlights the drastic physical change he undergoes.
plot_speculation.alternative: It could be viewed primarily as a logistical transition scene, but the dialogue elevates it to a thematic milestone.

plot_speculation.claim: The awakening scene establishes the triadic relationship between Neo, Morpheus, and Trinity that will drive the plot.
evidence: The scene is framed by the off-screen dialogue of Morpheus and Trinity confirming Neo's status.
Neo's first conscious words are directed at Morpheus, establishing him as the authority figure.
Trinity's presence and dialogue ('I hope you're right') introduce her as a key ally and observer of Neo's fate.
plot_speculation.alternative: The focus is primarily on Neo's individual survival, with the others acting as observers.

boundary_doubt: None. The scenes provided clearly delineate the physical transport through the pipes and the subsequent awakening on the ship, forming a coherent unit of action.

name: Reconstruction and Introduction to the Nebuchadnezzar
location: INT. HOVERCRAFT - INFIRMARY / INT. NEO'S ROOM / INT. MAIN DECK / INT. CONSTRUCT
what_happens: Neo wakes in the infirmary of the Nebuchadnezzar, his atrophied muscles being rebuilt by Morpheus and Dozer using acupuncture-like needles. After resting, he wakes in his room, discovers his physical modifications (grafted ports), and learns from Morpheus that the current year is approximately 2197, not 1997. Morpheus then leads Neo through the hovercraft, introducing him to the crew (Trinity, Mouse, Cypher, Switch, Tank, Dozer) and the Core, the ship's central technology hub. Finally, Neo is plugged into the Construct, a loading program where Morpheus visually demonstrates that the Matrix is a computer-generated simulation and shows Neo the true, ruined state of the real world.

entry_state.state: Unconscious or waking from a deep sleep after being unplugged from the Matrix; physically weak with atrophied muscles; believes it is 1997.

state_changes.before: Physically weak, atrophied, and disoriented; unconscious or semi-conscious in the infirmary.
state_changes.after: Physically restored enough to stand and walk; conscious and alert, though still disoriented by the new reality.
state_changes.why_it_matters: Establishes Neo's physical readiness for the exposition and subsequent training, marking the transition from patient to active participant in the Resistance.

state_changes.before: Believes he is in the year 1997 and that his 1990s city life is reality.
state_changes.after: Learns the year is approximately 2197, that his body has been modified with grafted ports, and that the Matrix is a computer program while the real world is a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
state_changes.why_it_matters: This is the core 'revelation' of the event, shattering Neo's previous understanding of time, space, and reality, and grounding him in the film's central premise.

exit_state.state: Physically recovered, mentally reoriented to the truth of the Matrix and the real world, and introduced to the crew and technology of the Nebuchadnezzar.

plot_speculation.claim: This event serves the thread of Neo's initiation and integration into the Resistance, moving him from a passive subject of rescue to an active agent who understands his environment.
evidence: Morpheus explicitly states, 'There is no reason for me to try to explain it when I can simply show it,' leading to the guided tour.
The introduction of the crew ('You know most of my crew... The ones you don't know...') establishes Neo's new social context.
The explanation of the Construct ('It is our loading program') and the Core ('where we broadcast our pirate signal') defines the tools Neo will use in future conflicts.
plot_speculation.alternative: It could be seen as a standalone exposition dump, but the physical reconstruction and crew introductions suggest a functional purpose for Neo's integration.

boundary_doubt: The boundary is clean. The event begins with Neo waking in the infirmary (sc-035) and ends with the conclusion of the Construct explanation and Neo's reaction (sc-040). The subsequent scene (sc-041/42) where Neo vomits and blacks out, followed by Morpheus's apology in Neo's room, feels like a distinct 'processing/reaction' beat that could arguably be a separate event or part of a 'Training' event, but the current boundary captures the 'Introduction' and 'Revelation' phases completely.

name: The History of the Machines and Neo's Rejection
what_happens: Morpheus uses the Construct to visually and verbally explain the history of the war between humans and machines, the origin of the fetus fields, and how humans are used as bioelectric power sources. This exposition culminates in Neo's mind rejecting the overwhelming truth. Back in the real world on the Nebuchadnezzar's main deck, Neo's body physically rejects the sudden influx of information. He thrashes and screams, requiring Trinity and Dozer to restrain him until the neural cable is removed. He then collapses into an unconscious state.

entry_state.state: Plugged into the Construct, eager to learn the truth but unaware of the physical reality of his existence
Preparing to reveal the full scope of the war and the Matrix's purpose

state_changes.before: Unaware of the physical reality of human existence in the real world and the cause of the war
state_changes.after: Informed that humans are grown in fields and used as biological batteries, but rejects this information
state_changes.why_it_matters: This is the first time Neo confronts the full horror of his reality, setting up his psychological struggle.

state_changes.before: Physically connected to the system, mentally resisting the new information
state_changes.after: Physically disconnected, mentally overwhelmed to the point of unconsciousness
state_changes.why_it_matters: The physical rejection demonstrates the danger of freeing a mind that isn't ready, as Morpheus later explains.

exit_state.state: Unconscious on the floor of the main deck, having vomited and blacked out
Observing Neo's reaction, aware that he broke the rule of not freeing minds past a certain age

plot_speculation.claim: This event serves the thread of Neo's psychological and physical integration into the real world, highlighting the difficulty of accepting the truth.
evidence: Morpheus' dialogue: 'The Matrix is a computer-generated dreamworld built to keep us under control in order to change a human being into this.'
Neo's reaction: 'No! I don't believe it! It's not possible!'
Cypher's observation: 'He's going to pop!'
plot_speculation.alternative: It could also be seen as a standalone exposition event, but the physical rejection ties it to Neo's character arc.

plot_speculation.claim: This event foreshadows the theme of belief and faith, which is central to Neo's development.
evidence: Morpheus' later dialogue: 'Faith is not a matter of reasonability. I do not believe things with my mind. I believe them with my heart. In my gut.'
Neo's rejection: 'I don't believe it! I don't believe it!'
plot_speculation.alternative: The theme of belief is more explicitly stated in later scenes, but this event sets the stage for it.

boundary_doubt: The boundary seems correct, as it covers the exposition and the immediate physical reaction. The subsequent scene where Neo wakes up and Morpheus apologizes is a separate event.

name: Morpheus Reveals the Prophecy
what_happens: Neo wakes in his dark room on the ship after a nightmare. Morpheus, sitting in the shadows, confirms that Neo cannot return to the Matrix due to the danger of his mind turning against itself, apologizing for breaking the rule against freeing older minds. He then reveals the core of his belief: that Neo is 'The One,' a prophesied figure born inside the Matrix who can remake it and end the war. Morpheus states that the search is over and that Neo's training is imminent.

name: Neo's Combat Training
what_happens: Tank initiates Neo's combat training on the Nebuchadnezzar's main deck by loading a 'Combat Series' disk (specifically Jujitsu) into Neo's neural port, bypassing standard operational programs. After a ten-hour download session, Neo wakes up physically exhausted but mentally confident, declaring he 'knows kung fu.' Morpheus challenges him to demonstrate, leading them into a simulated Japanese-style dojo. There, Morpheus explains the rules of the sparring program and tests Neo's abilities. Neo attacks with high speed and force, but Morpheus effortlessly blocks every blow, highlighting the gap between Neo's new technical knowledge and his lack of mental control or understanding of the program's nature.

Operator on the main deck, bored with routine tasks and eager to begin Neo's training.

name: The Rooftop Jump Training
location: INT. HOVERCRAFT / INT. CONSTRUCT - ROOFTOP / INT. NEO'S ROOM
what_happens: Following a sparring session where Neo defeats Morpheus, the crew prepares to load a new training program. Inside the simulation, Morpheus instructs Neo to overcome fear by jumping between two rooftops separated by a fifty-foot gap. Morpheus demonstrates the jump effortlessly, but Neo, plagued by doubt, falls short and crashes into a safety net. Back in the real world, Neo wakes up injured, spitting blood and cradling his ribs, learning that physical damage in the Matrix affects the body. The event concludes with Trinity bringing Neo dinner and Cypher questioning Morpheus's motives regarding the Oracle.

name: The Dojo Fight and Aftermath

what_happens: Mouse interrupts the crew's dinner in the mess hall to announce that Morpheus is fighting Neo, causing the crew to rush to the main deck to watch. Morpheus challenges Neo's belief that speed and strength are physical attributes, prompting Neo to realize that the environment is a program. The fight concludes with Neo landing a hit on Morpheus, leading to the loading of the rooftop jump program, which Neo fails to complete due to doubt. Upon waking, Neo spits blood, confirming to him that the pain and consequences within the simulation are real because his mind makes them so.

name: Street Training and the Agent Ambush
what_happens: Morpheus and Neo walk through a crowded simulated city street. Morpheus lectures Neo on the nature of the Matrix, explaining that the inhabitants are potential enemies because they are part of the system. As Neo is distracted by a woman in a red dress, Agent Smith suddenly appears and points a gun at Neo's face. Morpheus freezes time, explaining that Agents are sentient programs that can inhabit any person in the Matrix. He tells Neo that while previous fighters died because they were bound by the Matrix's rules, Neo will succeed because he can transcend those rules, implying he will eventually be able to dodge bullets. The lesson is cut short when Morpheus receives a call from Tank about trouble.

location: INT. NEBUCHADNEZZAR COCKPIT / EXT. SEWER MAIN

Neo asks Trinity about E.M.P.s, learning it is their only weapon against the machines. Morpheus physically restrains Neo to keep him from moving, warning that the Sentinel can hear them. name: The Oracle's Prophecy
what_happens: Neo and Morpheus arrive at the Oracle's apartment after a tense exchange in the hallway where Neo questions Morpheus's certainty given the deaths of five previous candidates. She then performs a casual physical examination and delivers her verdict: Neo is not 'the One' but possesses the gift and is waiting for something. She reveals that Morpheus believes in Neo so blindly that he will sacrifice his life to save Neo's, forcing Neo to choose between the two lives. name: Mouse's Death and the Hotel Raid
what_happens: Following the Oracle's prophecy that Neo must choose between his own life and Morpheus's, the crew returns to the Hotel Lafayette. Mouse is left behind in Room 1313 to monitor communications but is shot and killed by police when they breach the room. Agent Smith confirms the kill and locates the remaining fugitives on the eighth floor. Morpheus, guided by Tank over the phone, leads the crew through the building's internal plumbing walls to escape. During the descent, Cypher becomes wedged in the pipes, and the group is discovered by a cop who shouts that they are in the walls. A firefight ensues in the dark cavity. Agent Smith bursts through the wall, pinning Neo in a chokehold. Morpheus intervenes, sacrificing his freedom to hold Smith down while Trinity and Neo slide down the lath to the basement. They crash through the ceiling into a mechanical room, fighting their way into the sewers. Back in Room 608, Morpheus is overpowered by Smith and a wall of cops, and is captured. On the Nebuchadnezzar, Tank watches the monitors with growing dread, eventually shouting that it is a trap.
